title: Call Processing Pipeline Integration
description: Background worker for automated call processing pipeline. Polls for uploaded calls, executes transcription → AI extraction sequence, updates status, and handles retries. Fully integrated with transcription and call extractor services.
features: Auto-start on server boot (integrated in server.ts)
Polls for PROCESSING status calls every 5 seconds
Retry logic with exponential backoff (max 3 attempts)
In-memory job queue (can upgrade to BullMQ/Redis)
Manual trigger API for retry operations
acceptance_criteria: Worker starts automatically on server boot
Failed calls retry up to 3 times
result_summary: Complete background worker implementation with full pipeline integration. Auto-starts on server boot, processes calls asynchronously, handles retries and timeouts. Production-ready with proper error handling and logging. Android app backend fully functional end-to-end.
